summary: Rabbi Tawil examines Rambam's Hilkhot Tefillah regarding Torah and Haftarah readings for holidays and fast days throughout the year. He discusses the specific portions read on Shabbat Hol HaMoed, Hanukkah, Purim, Tish'a BeAb, and public fast days. He also explains the custom of reading special Haftarot during the three weeks of rebuke, the seven weeks of consolation leading up to Rosh Hashanah, and Shabbat Shuvah.
